title: Classification of Alzheimer's disease stages from magnetic resonance images using deep learning
summary: Primary PeerJ article/PDF Methods and Results report CNN/transfer-learning image classification on ADNI/OASIS MRI with test performance by stage; scope is retrospective benchmark classification.
ai_technology: Deep CNN family predicts Alzheimer stage labels from MRI. Results are strongest for AD/control and weaker for adjacent MCI groups; no clinical deployment claim.
